title: AC1018 TABLE direct-encoder extension-dictionary preflight
question: Does the bounded AC1018 TABLE direct encoder reject an extension-dictionary reference when its selected output route does not close that graph?

finding.before: DRW_Entity::encodeDwgCommon emits xDictHandle in the common handle stream. DRW_Table::encodeDwg did not reject a nonzero xDictHandle, while the bounded TABLE route does not stage or prove the referenced extension-dictionary graph.
finding.change: The AC1018 TABLE preflight now requires xDictHandle == 0. The generated vector seeds both destination buffers, verifies that a nonzero reference is refused without changing either buffer, clears the reference, and retries successfully on the same object.
finding.scope: Direct AC1018 TABLE frame admission only. This does not implement extension-dictionary graph output, qualify physical whole-source conversion, or establish native TABLE semantics.
finding.fixtures: No DWG/DXF fixture was added; the control uses a generated in-memory TABLE object.

validation.result: PASS: AC1018 TABLE encoder allocation failures injected=19 rollback=PASS retry=PASS; AC1018/AC1021 TABLE cell override vectors: PASS

limitations: The guard remains specific to the bounded AC1018 TABLE encoder.
Extension-dictionary support requires separately qualified identity, ownership, recursive closure, exact output, and readback evidence.
